sources.title: [13.1b] Beginners' Guide to Playing and Playing with Yuumi
Best Yuumi Build Guides 2026 for LoL Patch 26.19

passive.name: Feline Friendship
passive.text: Periodically, when Yuumi strikes a champion with an attack or ability, she restores health to herself and the next ally she Attaches to.While Attached, Yuumi generates a special bond with her allies. The ally with the strongest bond enhances Yuumi's abilities while she is Attached to them.

spells.name: Prowling Projectile
spells.text: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally.While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period.

spells.name: You and Me!
spells.text: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets. While on her Best Friend, she gains Heal & Shield Power and grants her Ally On-Hit healing.

spells.name: Zoomies
spells.text: Shields Yuumi and boosts Move Speed and Attack Speed. If she's attached, she passes it to her ally instead.

spells.name: Final Chapter
spells.text: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies. Yuumi can move, attach, and cast Zoomies! while channeling. While on her Best Friend, this spell also follows her mouse.

archetype.value: Yuumi is a versatile support who enhances allies in combat and helps with teamfights and picks.

axis.value: Yuumi can poke with Prowling Projectile, which deals magic damage and slows its target.

winCondition.value: Yuumi helps close games by supporting pushes toward objectives while maintaining vision.

spikes.why: Yuumi gains bonus effects on her abilities while attached to her Best Friend.

bait.why: After Yuumi uses Prowling Projectile, its damage and slow are unavailable during its 6.5-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Yuumi players can throw games by using experimental damage builds without getting very far ahead.
Yuumi misses her Best Friend enhancements when she uses abilities while attached to a different ally.
